tasks.short: Assign and supervise assistants and volunteers

steps.what: Plan assignments for teacher assistants and volunteers against classroom needs
Supervise assistants and volunteers and give feedback on their work

tasks.design: Keep assignment planning and supervision with the teacher, recording agreed duties in existing {DOCS}. Do not infer volunteer competence or automate staff evaluation from classroom records.
tasks.previous_blocker: Suitable assignments depend on trust, experience and current pupil needs.
tasks.enabler_now: A shared duty note can clarify expectations without a new allocation engine.
tasks.still_hard: Notice when assistance needs intervention and give useful feedback.
tasks.human_edge: Coach people while protecting pupils and professional boundaries.
tasks.altitude: The teacher retains assignment and supervision responsibility.

reach.learn: Describe observable performance and clear duties

evidence.claim: Assistant supervision requires direct observation and contextual judgement.

assumptions: Teacher elicits availability and checks permitted duties in s1; no free structured skills or availability feed is assumed.
Assistant and volunteer performance time is outside this focal task and unchanged.
Existing duty notes remain in use; no new application means zero incremental upkeep.
unknowns: Which duties each assistant or volunteer is permitted to perform
research_questions: Are agreed assignments clear enough for assistants to raise uncertainty promptly?

incremental.description: No additional allocation or evaluation system

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100; R=35+65=100. Planning, direct supervision and evaluation retain their time; no work is transferred or credited as saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Support library and supervise school transitions

steps.what: Confirm assigned library, hall, cafeteria or bus supervision duties
Assist in the library and monitor halls, cafeteria and bus loading or unloading

tasks.design: Use the existing duty roster in {CALENDAR} or {DOCS} and retain direct teacher presence. The word administrative does not make library assistance or student supervision a software-entry task.
tasks.previous_blocker: Most effort is physical presence and responsive assistance.
tasks.enabler_now: No new software mechanism replaces this duty safely or equivalently.
tasks.still_hard: Attend to changing student behavior and unsafe transitions.
tasks.human_edge: Intervene immediately and help individual children.

evidence.claim: Student transition supervision and library assistance require direct human work.

assumptions: School administration produces the existing duty roster; its scheduling effort is unchanged and outside this focal duty.
Teacher reads and confirms the assignment in s1. No location or behavior feed is assumed.
No new tools or records are added, so extra upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Which coverage and escalation arrangements apply
research_questions: Does the current roster make uncovered duties visible in time?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100; R=10+90=100. Reading the duty roster and performing the duty remain unchanged; no attendance substitution is counted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Attend staff meetings and serve on committees

steps.what: Review staff meeting agenda and committee papers
Attend staff meetings and contribute to committee decisions and commitments

tasks.design: Keep required attendance and committee deliberation with the teacher, using existing papers in {DOCS}. No automated delegate or transcript is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: The task involves contributing professional judgement and accepting commitments.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing shared papers support preparation without new software.
tasks.still_hard: Understand colleagues’ concerns and reach workable decisions.
tasks.human_edge: Bring classroom experience into collective decisions.
tasks.altitude: Participation rights and committee responsibility remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Present a clear recommendation with supporting facts

evidence.claim: Required committee participation cannot be treated as saved merely by producing a meeting summary.

assumptions: Meeting chair or secretary supplies the agenda and papers under the existing process; that work is unchanged.
Teacher preparation is counted in s1. Minute-taking and school-wide meeting administration are separate tasks.
No new workflow or application is proposed, so no incremental upkeep is required.
unknowns: Which attendance and voting requirements apply
research_questions: Which agenda items require preparation and a decision from each teacher?

incremental.description: No additional meeting technology to maintain

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100; R=25+75=100. Reading papers and participating retain their effort. No hypothetical meeting removal or shorter attendance is claimed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Select classroom materials and count usable supplies and equipment
Record inventories and draft orders for the selected classroom materials
Review quantities and submit the classroom supply requisition
Store equipment and supplies and issue materials for classroom use

tasks.design: Use a native classroom stock form in {PROCUREMENT} or an existing controlled {SPREADSHEET} to capture counts once and reuse catalogue descriptions in a requisition. The teacher chooses needs and quantities, approves the request and continues physical storage and issue.
tasks.previous_blocker: Copying count sheets into separate order forms repeats clerical effort.
tasks.enabler_now: Configured forms can reuse captured item identifiers and catalogue fields.
tasks.still_hard: Determine usable stock and suitable materials within school purchasing rules.
tasks.human_edge: Judge teaching suitability and notice damaged or unsafe equipment.
tasks.altitude: The teacher gains a simpler requisition draft; purchase authority remains with the school’s existing process.

reach.learn: Use catalogue identifiers and justified quantities

evidence.claim: Native stock and requisition forms can reuse entered item data; availability and savings depend on the school’s existing tools.

assumptions: Teacher produces item identification, usable_count and needed_quantity in s1; its full count and selection effort remains. Teacher captures those facts once in s2; the remaining 16.25 baseline units include capture, catalogue matching and manual handling of unmatched items.
Purchasing staff maintain approved catalogue item_id, description, unit and price under their existing process; no new demand forecast or free par-level feed is assumed.
Missing catalogue matches require manual clarification. Test native forms first; no automatic external purchase occurs and purchasing staff processing remains unchanged outside this task.
S4 includes physical storage and issue; neither loses time from a digital requisition.
unknowns: Whether inventory entry and requisition fields can already be reused
Which catalogue and purchasing permissions apply
research_questions: Does single capture reduce re-entry after counting and catalogue matching time are included?

already_counted.description: Capture counts and selected quantities and match items to the catalogue

incremental.description: Maintain classroom item aliases and locations
Maintain form mapping and catalogue access

approvals.approved_version: Teacher approves exact requisition revision including item identifiers, quantities, units and catalogue prices before internal submission; edits invalidate approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional E1: B=100; R=30+16.25+10+35=91.25; gross=8.75%; minus 1 focal upkeep gives 7.75% net. Low: current system already reuses counts or matching takes longer. High: repeated order entry shrinks; counting, selection, approval and physical handling retain time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Classroom supply entry may become lighter while the teacher retains supervision, staff coaching and committee participation.
reach: Prepare better catalogue-based requests for purchasing staff
Clarify assistant assignments with instructional coordinators
role.ambitious_version: Reduce repeated supply entry and preserve attention for students and colleagues.

job.title: Elementary School Teachers, Except Special Education
